name: Hidden Life
lines: Sign in to gather: what you find is kept against your account, in your backpack's stock.
You moved off before you were done.
Sign in, and what you win or find is kept in your backpack.
It is in your 🎒 Backpack, under Materials: sell it at a stall here or to the city, or use it at a forge.
Sign in to trade: gold and stock are kept against your account.
What you buy and sell is your stock: 🎒 Backpack, Materials.
The Weavers' Bridge over the Riven Deep
The shore of the Sunless Sea
Ysra lets you look for nothing: "A map is only worth having if it is used."
Second to the right, and straight on till morning. On a clear night, find the pair of bright stars low in the north-east, and fly.
At the far edge of the Nightmare Wilds, past the last dead tree, a lone pier runs out into the dark, and a ship waits at it.
The miners say the cage in the mine shaft goes further down than the mine. At the end of the old tunnel, one rune is warm under the hand.
Every fireplace burns unless somebody puts it out. Put one out, and look up the cold chimney.
The Wayfarer is the ship under your feet.
Coconuts, sailcloth, timber; Smee buys shells, pearls and feathers
Ten rings round the Never Peak
Think a happy thought, and fly
Welcome to Scheria, stranger. Strangers are sent by Zeus, we say. What does your ship need?
Olives, salt, timber, sailcloth; she buys your catch
work at the bench and make something
The bridge-weavers wind the silk from the old webs along the Riven Deep, and you weave it into cloth light as smoke. You are soft-spoken, exact and a little proud of your craft.
Silk from the Riven Deep. Touch it: lighter than breath, and it will hold a bridge.
You sell glowcaps and velvetcaps, and buy blind fish from the Darklake fishers. You are cheerful, chatty and full of mushroom recipes (simple and safe ones).
Glowcaps! Fresh from the Terraces this morning, as near as anyone can tell a morning down here.
Ore and coal; he buys rough gems and crystal
Glowcaps; he buys glowcaps and blind fish
Every place in the deep, and the way to it
work at the forge and make something
Weapons, armour, smelting: make it yourself, or commission it
Hello! Supply Shed's open. Boughs, holly, moss, ribbon, timber. What can I find you?
Boughs, holly, moss, ribbon and timber; Bramble buys what you gather
The right paper, the right ribbon
Fly through the rings in order: the next one is gold, the ones you have flown fade pale.
In Neverland you can fly: Space to rise, C to sink, and go where you look.
Finish the course and the fairies leave you a pinch of fairy dust (once in a while).
The clock starts when you press it
The flying school takes on instructors
Off you go! The first ring is gold, out over the island. Follow the arrow on the banner.
Peter crows from somewhere in the wood
The Never Rings: the course is cleared after ten minutes. Try again from the post by the Hangman's Tree.
Shorten sail first (S): you can't fish at full speed.
A silk line, a bent pin and a bit of glowcap for bait. The black water is very still.
A line and a hook over the side. Off Pylos and Ithaca the big tunny run.
Wait for the bite, then strike
The line drifts… wait for it.
Too soon: the fish was only nosing the bait.
Landed! (Sign in and what you catch is kept in your backpack.)
Landed, and let go: you have had your share here for now. Come back in
Each stone has its own note

Four stones, four notes. The stones sing a tune; sing it back by touching them in the same order. Each time you get it right, the tune grows by a note. Reach seven and the Listener says the stones may let you keep a sliver of crystal.
Seven notes, every one true. The stones hum together
It is in your 🎒 Backpack, under Materials.
Eight presents and ninety seconds. Each one has a tag: read it, and wrap it in the right paper with the right ribbon. Six or more right, and the wrappers give you their ribbon offcuts. Your best:
Oops: that one was meant to be
Six right wins the wrappers' ribbon. Have another go!
a little while ago. Win again in
Fresh fish anywhere; big tunny off Pylos and Ithaca
Buy salt, olives, sailcloth, timber; sell your catch
Deckhand, helmsman, lookout, cook, net fisher, carpenter
Work · real shifts, paid like any post in the city
A flying course round the Never Peak
Go back aboard the Wayfarer to fish from her rail.
At the Echoing Hollow: sing the tune back
At the end of Stillwater Landing
The shipwrights' yard is at the harbour of Scheria: set a course for it on the chart (M), and go ashore.
No forge in Neverland: the Lost Boys make do. The Tailors' Counter sells cloth for the forges in other worlds.
Work, trade, gathering and games in this world
